title: ENTRY
summary: Residential and community access control system. Has its own Supabase project. Brain may reference ENTRY decisions and architecture but must not read ENTRY operational data.

title: Seshat
summary: Minerva financial operating system and management-accounting product. Approved direction: evolve incrementally around real company/product/client economics, add business-unit and multi-currency controls before real Minerva financial use, and eventually migrate away from the current Supabase backend through a separate reviewed mission.

title: Minerva Web
summary: Public website for Minerva Technologies. Surface for product marketing and lead capture.

title: Minerva Core Brain
summary: Internal intelligence layer for Minerva: knowledge, decisions, prompts, agents, and inbox. v0 is Git-backed; v1 moves to Neon. Lives under app/(console)/brain in Minerva Console.

title: ENTRY Community Registration Foundation Contract
summary: Foundation contract for ENTRY Community Registration. Confirms Minerva Console ownership, the resident_activation_queue activation lane, legacy-lane boundaries, and readiness for ENTRY-ONB-001 without product implementation or migrations.

title: Minerva Field Foundation
summary: Planned mobile-first installable PWA surface inside Minerva Console for field operations across Minerva products. ENTRY is the first active module; Seshat and future products must fit the same Minerva-level field architecture without duplicating the full desktop console.
